column1: # ra1-classes.tsv — the four resource classes of SP-RA-1, as the runner writes them.
# Two sources meet in this file and acceptance/t04-runner.sh holds it against both:
#   the four `*_requested` / `*_limit` columns  are SP-RA-1's own table in 01-specification.md
#   cpu_weight, pids_max, io_latency_ms         are ruled in decisions/resource-contract.md
# A number that moves in one place and not in the other is drift, and the run fails — the same rule
# op5-policy.tsv lives by. It is embedded into the binary (go:embed) because a worker allocates
# without asking anything: R-A is a constant of the platform, not configuration of a node.
#   cpu_limit       -> the concurrency variables of SP-RC-5, in whole cores
#   ram_requested   -> memory.min       (the one memory knob that guarantees)
# memory.max and cpu.max appear nowhere on purpose. MB and GB in the panel are read as binary.
#   class  cpu_requested_milli  cpu_limit_milli  ram_requested_bytes  ram_limit_bytes  cpu_weight  pids_max  io_latency_ms
